description: Guard (016 T014p, round-7 review F1, b08). A pre block's closing line reopens a script; CommonMark ends the pre block there, and a div block starts on the next line and runs to the blank line. The opener after the script's close has no closer before that blank line, and raw HTML passes through, so the browser's comment hides the marker after it. The digest on disk carries only the visible rule, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. c565240 kept the reopened script open past the line where CommonMark ends its block, missed the block starting inside it, and on the close returned to inline text, so the opener was disarmed and the marker harvested.
